POKE (C-RAM: ramp step + wrap mask; D-RAM-register/mode-1 register file: the 32-cell signature table)

ranked.readback: AUDIO OUTPUT, and AC by construction — not a DC level. The probe generates its own ~200 Hz sawtooth on-chip, so the answer arrives as a repeating waveform that an AC-coupled send/return cannot swallow: capture the insert return as a 44.1 kHz WAV and read the transfer curve off one period (~220 samples). The observable is the number of distinct output levels per period and which of the POKEd signature values they are. GF1-3 are NOT used (unproven that the board wires them). No tone-generator-visible cell is used.
flaws: THE STIMULUS DOES NOT EXIST. i1 and i5 are the SAME word (0000204407) and i4 and i9 are the SAME word (0212200407), and nothing in the body moves the pointer: every class-2 and class-A word carries addr8=0x00, i.e. post-increment by 0. Under 'addr8 is the address in mode 0/2' the phase is read from cell 0x20 and both stores go to cell 0x00, so the phase cell is never written and acc is a frame-invariant constant. Under 'the pointer supplies the address' all four words touch ONE cell and i9 overwrites the phase with the post-C63 value every frame -- a feedback loop, not a ramp. Either way the input to i6 never sweeps, so A1==A0 follows for EVERY true reading of C63. The design's headline negative outcome is manufactured by its own body.

NO BEACON, and Phase 0 is circular. Project harness rule is 'a beacon first'. 0a ('POKE a cell to 0x7FFFFF, the output must show it'), 0b and 0c all read the output THROUGH the i6/i7/i8 idiom under test, so 'POKE never reached the register file', 'the idiom does not read the table' and 'C63 is inert' are ONE observation. The instrument check is not independent of the hypothesis it is supposed to gate.

i3 IS NOT A WRAP. 0094A00200 has hi12=0x094 => f31 = (0x094>>1)&7 = 2 = HOLD, an ANCHORED value: the accumulator is unchanged. There is no attested AND/mask operation and the probe therefore has no wrap mechanism. If the ~40-bit accumulator clamps rather than wrapping at the 24-bit store, the 'sawtooth' is a one-shot rail, and the capture shows one edge, not 220 samples of transfer curve.

THE RAMP STEP HAS NO ADDRESS. i2 multiplies coef[cursor++]; the body never resets the cursor (the known reset word 801.0.00.021 is absent), so the C-RAM cell 'POKE the ramp step' should target is whatever the kernel left the cursor at (measured 9 in one capture, not controlled). 'POKE the ramp step so the sawtooth is ~200 Hz' names no cell and is not executable as written.

0d, the load-bearing positive control, is not independent of the addressing question. It infers 'slot i6 executed' from 'the store at i9 moved' -- which only follows if i9 is pointer-addressed. Under addr8-is-address, i9 ignores the pointer, 0d fails, and a functioning probe is discarded as 'slot not executed'. Also the control word (lo12 0x821) is itself a bit-11 word and the design's i0 (801.0.PH.821, class 0) is NOT the resident pointer load (the kernel's is 08010C0821, hi12 0x080, class 1), so control and harness fall together.

R1 AND R2 ARE NOT SEPARATED. Because the body collapses to one or two cells with no pointer motion, acc and mem[p] carry the same value at i6, so 'index from acc' and 'index from mem[p]' predict the identical capture. Phase 2's rotation presumes four independently loadable sources, which needs pointer moves and ACT 0x13/0x14 stores the listed body does not contain.

Phase 2's fifth outcome ('four DIFFERENT flat levels => the source is accb') is not a code. Four different bodies differ in more than the one register they mean to differ in; any unintended per-arm state difference produces the same four-level signature. It cannot come out negative against 'some other state differed'.

NONE OF THE 11 WORDS IS IN THE 45-WORD PROVEN-RESIDENT SET (checked against wsa1/dsp/analysis/runtime-resident-iram-words.txt). All are from bodies the shipped firmware NEVER uploads, so every [P] tag reading 'the proven set' is false and the harness has no known-good core: if the body emits nothing, no word can be exonerated.

'EMULATOR FIRST' WILL MANUFACTURE THE NEGATIVE. The MAME device leaves exec_alu() at the lo12-bit-11 return for C63 (SS97 swallow census: 3 150 504 times, no SOURCE and no ACTION decode). A1==A0 is guaranteed in emulation by construction, and the WSA1R has no audio in MAME at all (wave ROMs NO_DUMP), so the mandated pre-flight validates nothing about Phase 1 while producing exactly the observation the design calls 'a clean refutation'.

READBACK OVERCLAIM. Felipe's WSA1R has NO digital output (his stated constraint); the capture is DAC -> analogue -> ADC with unknown gain and DC blocking. 'which of the POKEd signature values they are' is not readable absolutely -- only step COUNT and monotone ORDER survive. 44.1 kHz is also specified where the project's own recording rule says 96 k/24 precisely so staircase edges are not smeared.

DELIVERY AND EFFORT. LOAD and POKE do not exist yet (the monitor answers IDENT only), and the delivery route is a burned IC28 plus a socket swap on a rare instrument, then a hardware session. 'effort: medium' is wrong; this is the most expensive item in the hardware queue.

COVERAGE OVERCLAIM. Phases 1-2 address the C63 shape only (99 words). 8BC (49), 822, 839, 827, 864, 921, C62, F22 each carry a different selector and are untested; Phase 3's 'cells the corpus cannot supply' (mid 4/sel 0x21, mid 0/sel 0x63) probe field structure but unlock ZERO corpus words. 169 is not on the table from this design.
RUN n is decorative or harmful: the DSP host interface is write-only so RUN can report nothing, and if it halts the DSP it also halts the audio the entire readback depends on.
fixes: Rebuild the body with THREE distinct D-RAM cells and explicit pointer motion: phase cell P (read at entry, written back before the test word), test-input cell, output cell Q. Do not reuse one word for two roles. Then verify in MAME, with the I-RAM write tap plus a per-cell D-RAM census, that P ramps monotonically and Q tracks it -- before anything is burned.

ADD THE BEACON ARM: the same body with i6/i7/i8 all replaced by nops, storing the ramp straight to the output. A sawtooth must appear in the capture. This is the only arm MAME can honestly validate (it contains no bit-11 word), and without it no null in Phase 1 is interpretable.

Move the table-POKE instrument check OFF the probe: prove POKE reaches the mode-1 register file 0x1D..0x3C by poking a STOCK effect's sine table (flatten it, or make it asymmetric) and hearing the chorus/vibrato modulation change -- a context whose table read is already proven. Note this dependency is stronger than the design claims: LEDGER SS365 measured m_rf[m_dram_wp]=v, i.e. the register file IS written through the host D-RAM-register path, tag 0x15, recovered from a live EXCITER capture. 'INFERENCE' understates it.
Insert an explicit cursor reset (801.0.00.021) before the MAC and NAME the C-RAM cell the ramp step is poked into; otherwise the step size is inherited kernel state.

Drop the 'wrap' reading of i3 (f31=2 is HOLD). Either rely on 24-bit store overflow and PROVE in the emulator that the phase cell wraps rather than clamps, or re-arm the phase from the host between short RUNs.

Split 0d into two controls: (a) a word that provably moves the pointer, to test i9's addressing reading; (b) a word that stores an obviously different constant in slot i6, to test slot execution. As one control they are confounded.

Give Phase 2 genuinely distinct destinations (separate cells and ACT 0x13/0x14 temp stores) and run a per-arm control; delete the accb five-way inference, which cannot fail against 'the arms differed in something else'.
Record 96 k/24 with a no-stimulus window and the eff53_no_operation dry reference; report step COUNT and monotone ORDER (which is what Phase 3b actually needs), never absolute POKEd values.

State the load address (0x6E), the body entry/exit convention, and check the block terminator: SS122 established that the C-format payload is an I-RAM ADDRESS, so a verbatim-copied terminator may carry another program's next-block target.

Debug the harness against a bit-11 word that is ALREADY PROVEN to execute on silicon: 0819086822 (shape 822) is in the 45-word resident kernel and runs every frame in stock firmware. C63 is not resident anywhere. 822 can be attacked with POKEs and audio on a stock machine with no burn at all.

Run B2 (f31 3..7, 189 words) on this harness FIRST. It needs no table, no index and no sweep -- a known acc, a known operand, one word -- so it debugs the load/poke/audio chain at lower risk and, by the project's own ranking, higher words-per-effort; bit-11 should follow it, not precede it.
ranked.probe:
SELF-STIMULATING WAVESHAPER. Load a 11-word body into IC30 I-RAM; it builds its own sawtooth on-chip (so it needs no wave ROMs, no notes, no TG), feeds that sawtooth into the ONE word under test, and emits whatever comes out. [P] = a word copied verbatim from a shipped body / the proven set.

 i0  801.0.PH.821   ldptr #PH                 [P] point p at a scratch cell
 i1  0000204407     ld.st acc,(p)+4           [P] acc <- phase cell
 i2  0092A00200     mac.b c,c+,(p)+0          [P] acc += coef[cur++]   <- RAMP STEP (POKEd)
 i3  0094A00200     wrap  acc,c+              [P] acc &= coef[cur++]   <- RAMP WRAP (POKEd)
 i4  0212200407     mac.st acc,(p)+0          [P] phase cell <- acc (persists across frames)
 i5  0000204407     ld.st acc,(p)+0           [P] acc <- phase (the sweep variable)
 i6  >>> 0040000C63 <<<                       ***THE WORD UNDER TEST***
 i7  00006184CD                               class-6 consumer, addr8=0x18=24, verbatim
 i8  00124011CE                               class-4 third word of the idiom, verbatim
 i9  0212200407     mac.st acc,(p)+0          [P] body->output-stage cell <- acc
 i10 040010E000     endblk #0E                [P]

i1-i4 are prog50_vibrato w12-w15's own LFO idiom; i6-i8 are prog50_vibrato w20-w22 / prog06_ensemble w43-w45 verbatim. POKE the ramp-step coefficient so the sawtooth is ~200 Hz (220 samples/sweep). POKE the 32-cell mode-1 table 0x1D..0x3C to a SIGNATURE ramp: cell[0x1D+k] = k*0x8000. Then any lookup reports its own index in the output, and one captured sawtooth period IS the transfer curve.

PHASE 0 — instrument (run BEFORE the unknown; if it fails, stop and report nothing about C63):
 0a POKE one table cell to 0x7FFFFF -> the output must show that value. Proves POKE reaches the table and table->DAC is live.
 0b table flat (all cells equal) -> output must be a constant. 0c ramp step = 0 -> output flat (RULE 13 no-stimulus window).
 0d POSITIVE SLOT CONTROL: put the PROVEN 801.0.NN.821 in slot i6. The store at i9 must move to a different cell (output changes/goes silent). This proves slot i6 is EXECUTED at all — without it a null result is uninterpretable.
 0e run every arm twice, with and without a held note, in case the output stage is note-gated.

PHASE 1 — the word: A1 = C63 in i6; A0 = C63 replaced by proven nop 000.2.00.000; A1' = 0142000C63 with its own partner class-6 word 000061A407 (f31=1 arm, keeping the 99/99 f31<->partner-lo12 pairing); A2 = the deliberately MIXED pair (040...C63 + 407-partner) to test whether that correlation is causal or conventional; A4 = keep C63, replace the class-6 word i7 with nop.

PHASE 2 — source identification (only if A1 != A0). Four arms, rotating which of acc / tempA (ACT 0x13) / tempB (ACT 0x14) / mem[p] carries the sawtooth while the other three hold three DIFFERENT static constants. The arm whose output sweeps names C63's source. A fifth outcome (none sweeps, but the four arms give four different flat levels) means the source is accb — which also breaks the SRC 0x11 dependency cycle, since this is the first program ever to give accb a varying input.

PHASE 3 — the field decomposition, same scaffold, only lo12 changed: the two corpus minimal pairs (sel 0x21 mid 0 = PROVEN ldptr vs mid 1 = 0x921; sel 0x22 mid 0 vs mid 7) AND the cells the corpus cannot supply (mid 4/sel 0x21, mid 0/sel 0x63), plus mid 4 with addr8 = 0x00 / 0x05 / 0x80 to test 'mid != 0 => no payload' (p = 0.0885, suggestive only) by direct refutation.

PHASE 3b — count-vs-address: sweep the class-6 addr8 over {0x18,0x1A,0x1E,0x20,0x28} = ensemble's own four values plus the waveshaper's 40.
ranked.discriminates:
R1 C63 loads the table index FROM THE ACCUMULATOR (§195's reading): A1 shows a staircase whose levels are exactly our POKEd signature cells and which steps in lockstep with the sawtooth; A0 loses it; A4 (class-6 word removed) also loses it. Step widths further separate index = floor(acc*n/2^23) from acc>>18 from (acc>>19)&31 — three different step counts and three different wrap positions in one capture.
R2 index comes from tempA/tempB/mem[p]/accb, C63 merely moves it: A1 flat under the acc sweep but A1 != A0, and exactly one of PHASE 2's four rotations sweeps. Four-way code, so R2 is separated from R5 by the four arms giving four DIFFERENT flat levels rather than one identical level.
R3 C63 selects the table BASE (index from elsewhere): output flat within a period, but follows whichever 32-cell window we poke, and which window responds changes between A1 and A0.
R4 C63 IS the lookup (acc <- table[acc]), class-6 is the consumer: the staircase SURVIVES A4. R1 predicts it dies. This is the one arm that separates them and it is a single word swap.
R5 C63 inert: A1 == A0 sample-for-sample in all four PHASE-2 rotations.
COLLISION, stated plainly: R5 and 'C63 writes a register nothing in this probe reads' predict the SAME thing in PHASE 1/2 and are NOT separated there. PHASE 3 addresses it by running the same slot at sel 0x21, whose mid-0 meaning (the C-RAM pointer) is PROVEN BY CONSTRUCTION and whose register IS observable through i9's store target.
PHASE 3b: 'addr8 is a COUNT' predicts the level count per period equals addr8 exactly (24, 26, 30, 32, 40) with the value set unchanged; 'addr8 is an ADDRESS' predicts the count stays fixed and the value set shifts to a different poked window. Different observables, one capture.
ranked.negative: A1 and A0 identical sample-for-sample across the whole capture, in all four PHASE-2 rotations, AFTER phase 0d has shown that a PROVEN register-load in the same slot i6 does move the output. That is a clean refutation of §195 ('the C63 idiom's index is computed by C63 itself'): the 99 C63 words would then be a prefix/flag with no effect on the class-6 fetch, and the six failed emulator index arms would be explained. A second, weaker negative: phase 0a fails (POKE never reaches the class-6 table, or the body->output cell never reaches the DAC) — then the probe reports 'instrument absent' and says nothing about C63. Both are reportable results; neither is a pass by default.
ranked.control: A0: the byte-identical 11-word body with i6 replaced by the proven nop 000.2.00.000 — nothing else changed, same RUN length, same POKEs. Plus three further nulls run on BOTH arms: (i) ramp step coefficient POKEd to 0 (no stimulus — any structure seen here is instrument artefact, RULE 13); (ii) table poked flat (output must be constant, else the output is not coming from the table); (iii) the no-note / note pair, in case the output stage is gated. And the positive control 0d (proven ldptr in slot i6), without which a null is not interpretable.

ranked.readback:
AUDIO OUTPUT, as a TONE-CARRIER RATIO (primary, hardware-safe). Do not emit a DC level: the values planted into acc/accb/mem/tempA/tempB are not constants but five different C-RAM GAINS applied to the live input sample x[n] (external audio is measured to land in D-RAM 0x01/0x04; which cell is calibration step C1). Within one frame x[n] is a constant, so every plant scales the same sample and the emitted signal is k_j*x[n] — a scaled copy of the played note. A narrowband FFT magnitude at the note's fundamental names j by LEVEL: gains 1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16 give 0 / -6 / -12 / -18 / -24 dB, five separations with >40 dB of headroom. Because the answer is a RATIO to the input tone, it is immune to AC coupling and to the unknown output-stage gain.
Secondary, MAME-only: with no note playing the same rig emits a pure DC and yields the exact 24-bit value, which cross-checks the dB ladder.
NOT USED: GF1-3 (unwired/unlocated — doubly unproven). One free rider only: poll GF during the C2 calibration sweep and note whether any bit moves with the planted level. A constant GF costs nothing and rules it out.
DUMP is used only to read back CPU-2's staging buffer and confirm the monitor transmitted the microwords we asked for — the DSP itself is write-only.

CALIBRATION CHAIN, each a go/no-go with a known answer, run BEFORE any SRC-0x11 claim:
  C1 emit path: minimal program = read input cell, unity coef, store to Dt; sweep input cell x Dt until the played tone appears at the output. If no Dt reaches the output, STOP — nothing below is admissible.
  C2 resolution: sweep the unity coefficient 64/32/16/8/4; output must fall 6 dB per step. This PROVES the instrument can see a one-step difference, i.e. can see the failure.
  C3 pipeline alignment: vary the HOLD-filler count 0..3; lock the count at which the four anchored controls return their four known values.
  C4 nulls: all coefficients zero -> noise floor; no-note window -> noise floor (RULE 13).
flaws: THE A/B LOGIC IS EXACTLY INVERTED, and it mis-aims the whole design. upd6383.cpp:2143 (quoted in SPECULATIVE-APPLIED-REGISTER.md:8561) and data/PREDICT_SRC11_2026-09-13.md give arm A = `(specmask & 0x4000) && m_cur_unit1 ? m_accb : m_acc`, arm B = always accb. So in UNIT 0: A->acc, B->accb, C->mem[ptr] — three distinct values. In UNIT 1: A->accb and B->accb — IDENTICAL. The design asserts the reverse ("identical in unit 0, DIFFER ONLY in unit 1") and therefore makes dimension B (the unit-1 splice, its most expensive and least proven arm) the supposed sole discriminator, when unit 1 is the one body that cannot separate A from B. Worse, its stated fallback — "readout matches the SRC 0x10 control in unit 0 ⇒ arm A and arm B remain unsplit" — would throw away a decisive REFUTATION of arm B as inconclusive.

THE CHIP YOU CAN PROGRAM MAY NOT BE THE CHIP YOU CAN HEAR, and the design never names its target chip. wsa1/notes/FINDINGS-dsp-runtime-effect-uploads.md (measured, bus-level): IC30 = program DSP, 63 I-RAM words / 45 distinct, **C-RAM 0 cells at boot and still 0 after sweeping all 55 effects**; IC6/IC5 carry all the coefficients and have **0 I-RAM words**. With every coefficient zero, P=(coef*L)>>6 = 0, so IC30 as it runs today cannot be contributing anything audible — "the DSP is a send/return insert" is UNPROVEN for the only chip a LOAD can reach, and the chips that are plausibly audible have no program to splice. C1 is written as if this were a cell-search; it is a chip-identification question and it gates everything.

NO REHEARSAL AND NO DC FALLBACK: the WSA1R produces NO AUDIO in MAME at all (six wave mask ROMs undumped — wsa1/notes/DRIVER-IMPROVEMENTS-2026-09-05.md: "WSA1R audio is blocked at the undumped mask ROMs regardless", "it would produce no audio"). The "secondary, MAME-only" exact-24-bit DC readback does not exist. And running the probe in MAME instead would be circular — MAME's SRC 0x11 IS the thing under test. So every run is a one-shot on hardware belonging to someone who must be asked, with no dry run of the readout.

THE PLANTS CONTRADICT THEMSELVES: DC IN THE BODY, AC IN THE READBACK. Step 2 POKEs constants into S0..S3 and the body reads them at coef=64, so Va/Vb/Vm/Vt/Vu are DC — while the readback section forbids DC and asserts the values are "five different C-RAM GAINS applied to the live input sample x[n]". Both cannot hold. Making them scaled copies of x[n] requires every plant to read the SAME input latch cell (0x01/0x04) with FIVE DIFFERENT coefficients — which the body does not do, and which drags in a constraint the design never mentions: C-RAM is reached by a FREE-RUNNING CURSOR (class4 bit 3 = cursor-fetch, K4), not by an address field. You cannot assign "coef=64" to a word; you must fill the whole cursor path so the intended value lands at the intended fetch.

THE DRY PATH COLLAPSES THE LEVEL CRITERION. The readout is the FFT magnitude of the played note's fundamental, but a send/return insert puts DRY + WET at that same frequency, summed coherently with an unknown delay/phase. Against a 0 dB dry tone, gains 1/8 vs 1/16 differ by ~0.5 dB and the sign of the difference depends on phase — not "five separations with >40 dB of headroom". Unless a proven 100%-wet setting exists on this machine (unverified), several candidates produce the SAME observation, i.e. the criterion discriminates nothing on the platform it targets.

ONE GLOBAL FILLER COUNT CANNOT ALIGN THE LADDER. The project's own bit-exact result is L[N] = mem[N-1] (one-slot operand delay on the MEMORY path, coefficient one slot behind too). C3 sweeps a SINGLE filler count 0..3 and demands all four controls return their known values at one setting — but 0x07 sources memory (delayed) while 0x10/0x19/0x1A source registers (probably not delayed), and each `ldptr Sx` + reader pair in the plant block has the same hazard, unmitigated. If the path delays differ there is NO common filler count, and C3 reports "control negative / void" for a rig that is actually fine.

PRODUCT MISMATCH IN EVERY ANCHOR. The ALU model, ACT 0x13, ST07SIGN, the mode-1 register file, cells 0x01/0x04, the accb writer, and w64/w71 (SPECULATIVE-APPLIED-REGISTER.md:17187-8: KN5000 I-RAM 64 = unit-0 link vector, 71 = unit-1 link vector) are all KN5000/IC311 + MAME artefacts. The probe runs on the WSA1R's IC30, whose resident kernel is a DIFFERENT 63-word program at I-RAM 0x0030. "Kernel amble unchanged / kernel epilogue unchanged" is undefined for the machine the probe executes on; the proven cross-product match is the kernel HEADER, not the output stage. Separately, "unit" is overloaded: in WSA1R firmware unit 0/1/2 = IC6/IC5/IC30 (three CHIPS), not the KN5000's intra-chip unit-0/unit-1 — dimension B is written in KN5000 vocabulary and will be executed against WSA1R units if nobody catches it.

EVERY MICROWORD LITERAL IS MALFORMED. A 36-bit word is NINE hex digits (hi12.class4.addr8.lo12 = 3+1+2+3, e.g. the corpus's `C00.A.47.407`); the ESC is hi12 bit 11, inside the 12. All five literals have TEN (`0002000453` for what should be `000200453` — addr8 written with three digits). Loaded verbatim the fields shift by a nibble.

EFFORT IS MIS-STATED. 5 ladder members x 3 rotations x 5 classes x 2 units = 150 runs, plus 4 controls per configuration, plus a C1 search over ~0x3A D-RAM cells x input cells — each one a LOAD + POKE + MIDI note + recording cycle on a rare instrument, through a monitor that does not yet have LOAD/POKE/RUN/DUMP. That is not "medium". Dimension C also spends runs on addressing modes 3..6, which are UNCHARACTERISED — a separate axis with its own void risk.

COUNTING: the queue says SRC 0x11 is 171 sole (54 KN + 117 WSA), and RULE 9 says 730 pooled words are byte-identical replicas, so the WSA share must be de-duplicated before quoting; 139 is never sourced. §294 also warns explicitly that "unblocks 54" counts words refused for THIS AXIS ALONE — settling the SOURCE decodes nothing about the ACT codes or classes at those sites.
fixes: RUN UNIT 0 ONLY for the headline question. In unit 0 the three readings give acc / accb / mem[ptr] — three distinct values, one body, no setvec splice, no KN5000 epilogue dependency. Delete dimension B as the discriminator; keep a unit-1 arm only as a confirmation that A collapses onto B there.

SPLIT OFF THE PREREQUISITE AND RUN IT FIRST, STANDALONE: 'is IC30 audible at all?' POKE one IC30 C-RAM cell non-zero (its C-RAM is provably untouched by the firmware, so nothing overwrites you) and listen for any change against a silence null. If IC30 is inaudible, the whole axis needs a different chip or a different readback and no ladder run is admissible. Cheap, decisive, and it is the real content of C1.

PICK ONE PLANT MECHANISM. Either all-DC (and then you need a DC-capable readout, which Felipe's constraints — no digital out, AC-coupled analogue — deny), or all-AC: every plant reads the SAME input latch cell with a DIFFERENT coefficient, and you lay the coefficients out along the CURSOR PATH, not by word. Write the cursor budget explicitly, word by word.

REPLACE THE LEVEL READOUT WITH A PARAMETRIC ONE. HARDWARE-EXPERIMENTS-WSA1R.md already sanctions rate / delay-in-samples / curve / decay-time as the measurements that survive the DAC. Make the five candidates differ by a DELAY (echo spacing) or a MODULATION RATE rather than a gain, so the answer is not at the excitation frequency and the dry path cannot bury it.

ALIGN EACH PATH SEPARATELY. Sweep the filler count independently per plant/read pair and report the per-source alignment table as a result in its own right (memory-sourced vs register-sourced L delay is itself undecoded and worth knowing). Do not gate the run on one global count.

RE-DERIVE THE AMBLE/EPILOGUE FROM THE WSA1R'S OWN 45 RESIDENT WORDS (the 63-word image at I-RAM 0x0030, runtime-resident-iram-words.txt), not from the KN5000 kernel. Say in the design which of IC5/IC6/IC30 each word targets.
FIX THE LITERALS to nine hex digits and print them in the corpus's dotted form (`000.2.00.453`) so a field slip is visible on inspection.

DROP THE GF RIDE-ALONG or make it real: with no GF-setting instruction in the probe body, a constant GF proves nothing and a moving GF bit is uninterpretable. If you want it, put a candidate GF-setter in the body and treat it as its own axis.

ranked.probe:
THE KEY: `dsp/instruction-set.md` gives the ALU as `L := src[lo12[10:6]]` with 0x07=mem[p], 0x10=acc, 0x19=tempA, 0x1A=tempB ALREADY ANCHORED, and `lo12[4:0]=0x13 -> tempA <- L`. So SRC 0x11 sits in a five-word ladder identical in all 36 bits except lo12[10:6], four of whose members have KNOWN answers. This is not a capture campaign (the standing prohibition); it is the "hardware / bit-encoding" break that DSP-DATAPATH-DECODE-HANDOFF names as the only way out of the cycle.

THE LADDER (class 2 = pointer, addr8=0x00 so the pointer does NOT move; hi12=0x000 so bit4=0 no store-clear, f31=0):
  00020001D3   SRC 0x07 mem[p]  ACT 0x13  -> tempA <- Vm   CONTROL, known
  0002000413   SRC 0x10 acc     ACT 0x13  -> tempA <- Va   CONTROL, known
  0002000653   SRC 0x19 tempA   ACT 0x13  -> tempA <- Vt   CONTROL, known (self-copy)
  0002000693   SRC 0x1A tempB   ACT 0x13  -> tempA <- Vu   CONTROL, known
  0002000453   SRC 0x11 ???     ACT 0x13  <-- THE ONE WORD UNDER TEST
ACT 0x13 (not 0x07) is chosen so the destination (tempA) is disjoint from the pointer cell: with ACT 0x07 a mem[ptr] reading is a self-copy and is INDISTINGUISHABLE from "the word never executed". It also dodges §40 ST07SIGN's pre/post ambiguity entirely.

SETUP, per run (everything below is a kernel/anchored form; only addr8, lo12[10:6] and C-RAM data vary):
 1. Select NO OPERATION (a byte-verified pass-through) on the panel, then stop touching it — later C-RAM POKEs must not be overwritten by a firmware re-upload.
 2. POKE D-RAM (tag-0x15 value packets, the same path the host's zero-fill uses) seed cells S0..S3 and the probe cell Dt with four distinct values.
 3. LOAD the spliced body into I-RAM: kernel amble unchanged, then
      ldptr S2 ; class-A `SRC 0x07 / ACT 0x13`, coef=64 (unity, since P=(coef*L)>>6)  -> tempA <- Vt
      ldptr S3 ; class-A `SRC 0x07 / ACT 0x14`, coef=64                               -> tempB <- Vu
      ldptr S1 ; class-A `SRC 0x07`, f31=0, coef=64 -> acc <- Vb
                 the LOCATED accb-writer (class 1 / hi12=0x400 / ACT 0x07)            -> accb <- Vb
      ldptr S0 ; class-A `SRC 0x07`, f31=0, coef=64 -> acc <- Va
      ldptr Dt ; (cell already holds Vm)
      <one HOLD filler, f31=2, no store -- coef pipeline depth 1, L[N]=mem[N-1]>
      *** THE PROBE WORD ***
      0002000647  (SRC 0x19 tempA / ACT 0x07, class 2, addr8 0) -> mem[Dt] <- tempA
      kernel epilogue unchanged.
 4. Hold a note (RULE 12), RUN for >= 0.5 s of frames, capture audio.
 5. Repeat for all five ladder members. The answer is which of Va/Vb/Vm/Vt/Vu comes back.

THREE DIMENSIONS ON TOP, all cheap because only data or five bits change:
 A. SWEEP: run each ladder member at three different plant assignments (rotate Va,Vb,Vm,Vt,Vu through five levels, a Latin square). The readout must TRACK one candidate across all rotations. This is what makes "it returned Vm" falsifiable rather than coincidental.
 B. ★ UNIT SPLIT — this is what breaks the documented cycle. Arm A says `cur_unit ? accb : acc`; arm B says always accb. Splice the SAME body once as the unit-0 body and once as the unit-1 body (the epilogue's w64/w71 setvec words link/disconnect each unit). Arm A predicts acc in unit 0 and accb in unit 1; arm B predicts accb in both. No capture campaign can do this; controlling the program does.
 C. CONTEXT SPLIT (the SRC 0x00 / SRC 0x0B precedent): repeat the whole ladder with class4 = 2, A, 0, 1, 6. Each class carries its own four controls, so each class gets its own independently-validated answer. A per-class answer table is a legitimate, publishable outcome.
 D. ABLATION: drop the accb-writer word (replace with the HOLD filler). Only an accb reading may change; it should fall back to accb's resting value, which is itself measurable and frame-stable (the documented kernel-B constant in program 0).
ranked.discriminates:
Each reading predicts a different member of {Va, Vb, Vm, Vt, Vu} in the readout cell, and a different pattern across the sweep, the unit split and the ablation:

 acc (arm A, shipped): readout = Va; bit-identical to the `0002000413` control in every rotation; UNIT SPLIT -> acc in unit 0 AND accb-valued in unit 1; ablating the accb-writer changes nothing.
 ACCB (arm B): readout = Vb in BOTH units; ablating the accb-writer moves it to accb's resting constant; ablating the acc plant changes nothing. Arm A and arm B are identical in unit 0 and DIFFER ONLY in unit 1 — dimension B is the only thing in the design that separates them, and it is the exact split the dependency cycle was blocking.
 mem[ptr] (arm C, §113): readout = Vm; bit-identical to the `00020001D3` control; tracks the D-RAM POKE; changing the probe word's addr8 to a non-zero offset moves the answer to the new cell (acc/accb readings do not move with addr8).
 tempA (0x19) / tempB (0x1A): readout = Vt / Vu, matching the `0002000653` / `0002000693` controls. Currently not proposed by anyone, but they are live codes and the ladder tests them for free.
 CONTEXT SPLIT: if the class-2, class-A, class-0, class-1 and class-6 ladders return DIFFERENT sources, SRC 0x11 is field-split exactly as SRC 0x00 and SRC 0x0B are. Each class has its own four anchored controls, so a per-class answer is self-validating.

NO TWO CANDIDATES PREDICT THE SAME THING anywhere in the matrix, because all five plants are made distinct BY CONSTRUCTION and are rotated. The one genuine degeneracy in the naive design — mem[ptr] self-copy versus "the word does not execute" — is removed by using ACT 0x13 (destination tempA, disjoint from every source) instead of the corpus's ACT 0x07.
ranked.negative:
Four distinct ways this comes out negative, and each is reported as such rather than dressed as an answer:

 1. RIG NEGATIVE (C1/C2 fail): no Dt reaches the output, or the 6 dB ladder is not monotone/resolvable. The instrument cannot see the difference, so absence of a difference proves nothing. No SRC-0x11 claim is admissible; report "readout not established".
 2. CONTROL NEGATIVE: the four anchored ladder members (0x07/0x10/0x19/0x1A) do NOT return their four known distinct values at any filler alignment. The splice or the plant block is broken — most likely the D-RAM POKE path does not reach arbitrary cells, or the spliced I-RAM was overwritten. Result void.
 3. SOURCE NEGATIVE: the SRC-0x11 arm returns a level equal to NONE of {Va,Vb,Vm,Vt,Vu} and is not a simple function of them (e.g. their sum, or a fixed constant). Then SRC 0x11 is a source not in the planted set — P, the bus/DI latch, a coefficient, or an internal register. Positive information, but the axis stays open until a second ladder plants those.
 4. TRACKING NEGATIVE: the SRC-0x11 arm matches one candidate in rotation 1 but not in rotations 2 and 3. The single-rotation match was coincidence; the answer is withdrawn. This is the specific failure that the Latin square exists to catch, and it is the one that would otherwise have produced a confident wrong decode.

Additionally, a null that is NOT a failure: if the readout matches the SRC 0x10 control in unit 0 and the unit-1 splice cannot be made to run, arm A and arm B remain unsplit and the honest report is "SRC 0x11 = the current unit's accumulator in unit 0; the A/B split is untested".
ranked.control:
FOUR CONTROLS, run in every configuration:
 (1) POSITIVE CONTROL WITH A KNOWN ANSWER — the four anchored ladder members `00020001D3`, `0002000413`, `0002000653`, `0002000693`. They are bit-identical to the probe word except lo12[10:6], so they exercise the identical splice, plant block, pipeline alignment and emit path, and their four answers are already decided by the published ALU model. If they do not return Vm, Va, Vt, Vu respectively, nothing else in the run is admissible. This is the "prove the instrument can see the failure" gate.
 (2) NO-OP NULL — probe word replaced by the proven HOLD filler (f31=2, no store): tempA must still hold Vt and the readout must equal Vt exactly. Separates "SRC 0x11 read something" from "the word did not execute".
 (3) SILENCE / NO-STIMULUS NULL (RULE 13) — same program, no note held, and separately all C-RAM gains zeroed: output must sit at the measured noise floor. A difference from silence is not a signal; this fixes the floor the dB ladder is quoted against.
 (4) UNTOUCHED-DATA NULL — POKE a D-RAM cell and a C-RAM cell that NO word in the spliced body reads; the output must not move. Detects "any POKE perturbs the sound" artefacts and confirms the firmware is not re-uploading over us.
 Plus the ablation control (drop the accb-writer word) and the per-class control set, which give the per-category control run WITH the test rather than after it (the method rule earned in §318).

commands: LOAD (I-RAM microwords into IC30 at the kernel load address 0x30; ~35 words per variant)
POKE (C-RAM for the carrier-path coefficients; descriptor if the program length must be set)
RUN (needs free-run or n >= 22050, i.e. >= 0.5 s of audio, not a few frames)
DUMP (OPTIONAL — only to verify the monitor's own staging buffer before LOAD; CPU-2 RAM holds nothing DSP-side)
ranked.readback: AUDIO OUTPUT, as tone-present / tone-absent — NOT a DC level and NOT GF. A 1 kHz sine at -20 dBFS is injected into the effect send; the measurement is narrowband RMS at 1 kHz on the instrument's analog output over a 0.5 s window. Present (>= -35 dBFS) = 1, absent (noise floor) = 0. Each run yields one bit; four runs spell out a 4-bit address. DC readback is deliberately avoided because the analog output is almost certainly AC-coupled — an unproven assumption this design does not have to make. GF1-3 are not used at all; if they turn out to be wired, each 4-run binary readout collapses to 1 run and the whole matrix shrinks ~4x.
flaws: CARRIER IS UNBUILDABLE AS SPECIFIED. Felipe's constraint #1 in kn7000_mame/notes/HARDWARE-EXPERIMENTS-WSA1R.md: 'No audio input. All excitation must come from the machine's own tone generator.' There is no effect send to inject a 1 kHz -20 dBFS sine into. The carrier must be a MIDI-driven TG note: not a sine, unknown absolute level, so the 'held at -20 dBFS to stay clear of Q23 clamping' mitigation has no basis either.

THE CRITERION CANNOT COME OUT NEGATIVE (dry leak). The carrier is the note being played; the DSP is a send/return insert, so the dry note reaches the same output at the same frequency. 'Narrowband RMS at 1 kHz >= -35 dBFS = 1' is positive in EVERY run, including the NOP null and the X=0 control. Wet-only is not established: the same notes file says '100 % wet if the machine allows it'. Best case the null shows 1111 and the whole matrix aborts; worst case every bit reads 1.

THE PROBE WORD DESTROYS ITS OWN READOUT CELL. 012.X.dd.1CE has hi12 = 0x012: HI_ST (bit 4) set, f31 = 1 (ADD). It is a store word ('mem[?]<-acc, acc=0', cf. kernel w38/w47). In the POINTER run acc is preset to 0, so the word writes 0 into its target. If the store target is mem[p] under either pre- or post-increment, the cell S6 then reads is the cell just zeroed => tone absent => k=0000 — the SAME observation as 'no move'. Stage C therefore cannot separate V0 from 'pre-increment + store', and would reproduce §161's downgraded claim as an artefact of the probe.

THE PAINT STAGE CANNOT PAINT. w47 = 'mac (p),(p)+1 ; mem[p]<-acc, acc=0' — the store ZEROES the accumulator, so the second and every later copy stores mem[p]xK (stale data rescaled), not the carrier. The carrier can only be reloaded into acc by w32, which reads at the CURRENT pointer — i.e. at the ruler cell being walked, not at the input cell. Reloading requires an ldptr per cell, which is itself synthesis. The 'binary-weighted ruler' as written writes the wrong values into cells 2..N.

RULER DYNAMIC RANGE. 'up to 8 copies' of the paint word paints at most 8 cells (realistically ~3 words per painted cell once the carrier reload is included), yet the readout is claimed to be 4 bits (16 cells) and optionally 6 bits (64 cells). Worse, dd in {0x10,0x40,0x7F,0x80,0xFF} lands outside any feasible window, so 'moved by dd' reads identically to 'did not move' — which is exactly where zero- vs sign-extension, wrap/modulo and absolute-jump were supposed to be separated. Those four readings collapse onto one observation.

THE LOAD ADDRESS DESTROYS THE ONLY PROVEN PLUMBING. Measured in kn7000_mame/notes/HARDWARE-CUSTOM-DSP-PROGRAMS-WSA1R.md §A0: IC30's I-RAM is written exactly once, kernel at 0x30..0x6E, and 0x6E is the insertion point the machine already expects and never fills. Loading ~35 words at 0x30 discards the input stage, the output stage, the host-patched effect-RETURN level words (KN5000: I-RAM 64/71, repatched on EVERY effect change, dsp-perframe-execution.md) and the frame terminator; stale kernel words past the probe keep executing; and kernel w62 (0C00DC0407 = C00.D.C0.407, disassembled '#iw110') branches to 0x6E, so 'the kernel terminator verbatim' jumps into uninitialised I-RAM.

RE-ORDERING BREAKS THE COEFFICIENT CURSOR, AND STAGE D IS CONFOUNDED BY CONSTRUCTION. Coefficients are consumed by cursor position (kernel.dsm marks C-RAM[0x00]/[0x01] at w59/w60), so inserting or removing any cursor-fetch word shifts every later coefficient — including the output level — and a zero coefficient reads as 'tone absent' = k=0. Class B/C/D/E differ from 3/4/5/6 by consuming one extra C-RAM cell, so any difference between twin and partner is attributable to the cursor shift, not to bit 3. §161's 'class C == class 4' assumption is untestable this way.

NO PER-RUN LIVENESS WITNESS. Every failure mode above (dead coefficient, bad terminator, probe word suppressing the frame, wrong base) outputs silence, and silence is this design's '0'. Aborts (a)/(b)/(c) are whole-campaign checks, not per-run ones; a mode that silences the frame at some dd values and not others reads as a plausible displacement pattern. Prove the instrument can see the failure IN THE RUN THAT REPORTS IT.

THE TWO-BASE ARM IS UNCONTROLLED AND SELF-DEGENERATE. The base comes from varying w0's ldptr immediate (0801.0.C0.821 — one site, one value 0xC0 in the whole corpus). If that field is not the pointer base, both 'bases' are the same cell — which is precisely the signature the design assigns to 'p <- addr8 absolute'. No known-answer control (X=0/X=2) is run at base 0x80, so the one axis that only exists to test absolute addressing has no null.

WORD COUNT INFLATED. I reproduced 225 from the two listing trees (class 3: 14, class 4+C: 46+53+7 = 106, class 5+D: 6, class 6: 99) — but these are RAW OCCURRENCES, not RULE-9 de-duplicated (the WSA1R tree's 60 records are 52 distinct programs; the one mode-4 shape 00124011CE occurs 198 times). And the class-6 99 ARE the C63 lookup idiom: addr8 there is already read statically as an ENTRY COUNT (§156-§159, surviving), and the block is blocked on the INDEX, not the addressing. Settling class-6 addressing decodes none of them.

EFFORT IS NOT 'MEDIUM'. The monitor is at milestone 2 (PEEK of CPU-1 RAM over MIDI, WSA1R-SYSEX-MONITOR-BUILD.md). LOAD/POKE must cross the CPU1->CPU2 link to the DSP host port (designed, unbuilt), then a prom_a burn and socket swap on a rare instrument, then the run matrix as written is ~550 audio takes (stage C alone is 4 modes x 9 dd x 2 bases x 4 bits = 288), ~1100 with any complement control.

MODE 3's 'NO SYNTHESIS NEEDED' IS WRONG, AND MODE 3 MAY BE INVISIBLE. w39/w48 appear ONCE EACH in the 63-word kernel, not '12x per frame', and both print as ?word SPECULATIVE in kernel.dsm — the ALU half is unanchored, not proven. Both are f31 = 2 (HOLD) with HI_ST clear, so if mode 3 does not move the pointer the word has no observable effect at all: the §149 invisible-axis outcome, not a decode.

'EXACTLY ONE WORD IS NEW' IS FALSE. The varied ldptr immediates (S0, S3, the absolute-read ldptr #A), the register read at index dd (w3's shape with addr8 swept), and the 16-word OR-chain accumulate words are all synthesised shapes on unproven fields. The advertised minimal-pair discipline does not hold outside S5.
fixes: Load the probe at 0x6E as a BODY and leave the 63-word kernel intact — input stage, output stage, host-patched return-level words and frame terminator all keep working, and w62 already branches there. This is the project's own measured insertion point (§A0) and it removes flaws 6 and most of 7.

Respecify the carrier: a held MIDI note (fixed pitch, fixed velocity, RULE 12) chosen near the detection frequency; calibrate absolute level by measurement before quoting any headroom argument. Drop the '1 kHz sine at -20 dBFS injected into the send'.

Make every bit DIFFERENTIAL and paired: two runs per question, cell-painted vs cell-zeroed, and accept the bit only if exactly ONE of the pair sounds. Dry leak cancels, and the pair is its own per-run liveness witness. Before any of it, A/B a loud effect against eff53_no_operation on the same note to prove the wet contribution is measurable at all, and establish whether 100 % wet is reachable on this machine.

Run the pointer sweep with HI_ST CLEAR (e.g. hi12 0x002 in place of 0x012) so the word cannot overwrite the cell being read; ask the store question in a separate, explicitly acc = carrier program. One question per program.

Replace the binary ruler with one-hypothesis-per-run: enumerate the candidate landing addresses first (B, B+dd, B+1, absolute dd, B+dd mod N, out-of-window), paint exactly the one cell a named candidate predicts, and read at the pointer. Each run is a yes/no against a named prediction with its complement as control, and 'out of window' becomes an explicit hypothesis instead of the default reading of silence.

Cursor-balance every arm: each variant must execute the same number of cursor-fetch words as its control (pad with a cursor-fetch nop), and verify the balance by checking a known coefficient-dependent output level is unchanged. Without this, stage D is uninterpretable.
Run the X=0 and X=2 known-answer controls at BOTH bases; treat 'the base change moves a known-answer landing' as a gate that must pass before the absolute-addressing reading is even considered.

Dress-rehearse the entire skeleton in MAME first (the monitor is already validated there and D-RAM is readable): the paint must produce the intended cell contents, the X=0/X=2 controls must reproduce, the output must stay audible, the terminator must hold. Only the open-mode arms need silicon; this removes nearly all abort risk before Felipe touches the instrument.

Establish whether the WSA1R repatches individual I-RAM words at runtime (the KN5000 repatches I-RAM 64/71 on every effect change); place the probe clear of those slots and freeze the panel/MIDI program changes for the duration of a run, since effect changes also re-stream C-RAM onto the resident program and would clobber POKEd coefficients mid-take.

Re-quote the prize after RULE-9 de-duplication, drop class 6 from it (blocked on the index, addr8 already read as an entry count), and pre-register per stage which of §348's TWO open axes (class 4, bit-4 store on class 4) it closes — closing one and promoting is the exact error §348 retracted.
ranked.probe:
SYNTHESISE the minimal pair the ROM refuses to supply. §165's objection ("selecting programs by membership presupposes the answer") dies because no program is selected: we build one, and we choose the base, the displacement and the memory contents.

THE ONE-DIGIT EDIT. WSA1R kernel w38 is `00122FF1CE` = `012.2.FF.1CE`, w47 is `00122011D5` = `012.2.01.1D5`. The mode-4 witness is `012.4.01.1CE` — the SAME hi12, the SAME lo12 as w38, the SAME addr8 as w47, differing from a proven word in the CLASS NIBBLE ALONE. So the word under test is written `012.X.dd.1CE`, X the class nibble, dd the displacement byte. Mode 3 needs no synthesis at all for its ALU half: `104.3.40.1CE`/`104.3.40.1D5` are kernel w39/w48 and execute 12x per frame on real silicon; only addr8 is varied.

SKELETON (every word verbatim from the 45 resident kernel words, re-ordered; exactly ONE word is new):
  S0  w0    08010C0821  ldptr #$c0          C-format immediate varied -> pointer base B
  S1  w32   080080A000  ld.b (p)0,c         acc <- live input (the carrier)
  S2  PAINT: up to 8 copies of w47's shape `012.2.aa.1D5` (mac (p),(p)+1 ; mem[p]<-acc, acc=0)
      writing acc into successive ruler cells; interleaved with w42 `0000200000` nop where a 0
      is wanted. This paints the 16-cell RULER at B..B+15.
  S3  w0 shape again: ldptr #B   (pointer reset to a known base)
  S4  acc preset: acc <- carrier (w32) for the STORE run, or acc <- 0 (w42 after a w47) for the
      POINTER run.
  S5  *** THE WORD UNDER TEST ***  `012.X.dd.1CE`
        X in {3,4,5,6}          the open modes
        X in {B,C,D,E}          their cursor-fetch twins (tests §161's "class C == class 4")
        X in {0,2}              KNOWN-ANSWER CONTROLS, published behaviour
        dd in {00,01,02,04,10,40,7F,80,FF}
  S6  READOUT: `080080A000` shape at the CURRENT pointer, no move (pointer run), or preceded by
      ldptr #A for an absolute read (store run), or w3's shape `222.1.AA.1CD  mac rAA` to read
      register file index AA.
  S7  OUTPUT: kernel w59/w60/w61/w62 verbatim (deposit + output stage) + the kernel terminator.

THE RULER IS BINARY-WEIGHTED, NOT A LEVEL. A 1 kHz sine at -20 dBFS is fed into the effect send.
Run r (r = 0..3) paints the CARRIER into every ruler cell whose (address - B) has bit r set, and 0
into the rest. Tone at the output => bit r of the landing address is 1. Four runs read the 4-bit
displacement; six runs read 6 bits. The answer is therefore a presence/absence bit, contrast >= 50
dB, never a DC level.

THE ACCUMULATOR IS AN OR-DETECTOR. f31=1 is ADD, so a chain of 16 read-and-accumulate words sums 16
cells; the carrier appears if ANY of them holds it. That makes an exhaustive search for the store
address cost 16 runs (block scan of 256 cells) + 16 runs (localise inside the hit block), not 256.

RUN ORDER (stop at the first failure):
  A. KNOWN-ANSWER CONTROL. Same skeleton, X=2, dd in {00,01,02,04,10,FF}. The 4-bit readout MUST
     return exactly s8(dd) mod 16, and X=0 MUST return 0 for every dd. If the skeleton cannot
     reproduce the two characterised modes, nothing it says about 3/4/5/6 is admissible. This is
     the "prove the instrument can see it" gate, against a published answer rather than a guess.
  B. NULL. S5 replaced by w42 nop: readout 0, carrier present at mem[B]. Plus the stock unmodified
     kernel with the same carrier and no probe (the no-stimulus window, RULE 13).
  C. POINTER SWEEP. X in {3,4,5,6} x 9 displacements x 2 bases (B = 0xC0 and 0x80), 4 readout runs
     each. Run >= 8 frames before measuring (bodies read last frame's state; the +1.0 s / +2.5 s
     priming systematic is a known instrument artefact).
  D. CURSOR TWINS. X in {B,C,D,E} at dd = 01 and 04.
  E. STORE TARGET. acc = carrier, all ruler cells and registers 0x01/0x05/0x40/0x80/0xC4 painted 0.
     Read (i) mem[B], (ii) mem[B+k] with k from C, (iii) reg[dd], (iv) reg[0xC4] as a decoy; then
     the 32-run exhaustive block scan if none hit. Positive controls in the same skeleton: X=2 must
     put the carrier at mem[B] and NOT in the register file; `212.1.dd.000` (w5's shape) must put it
     at reg[dd] and NOT in D-RAM. Sweeping dd over four values proves the index is addr8 and not a
     constant — the degeneracy the ROM cannot break, since all 99 mode-4 words carry addr8 = 0x01.
ranked.discriminates:
Readout = the 4-bit offset k of the cell the pointer ends on, measured at two bases; plus the cell the bit-4 store lands in.

  no move (V0, §161's downgraded claim)   k = 0 for every dd, both bases
  p += s8(addr8) (V7)                     k = dd; dd=FF -> k = 15 (cell B-1); base-independent
  p += 1 always (addr8 means something
    else, e.g. class 6's entry count)     k = 1 for every dd
  p <- addr8 absolute                     SAME ABSOLUTE CELL at both bases => the two bases
                                          disagree by (B1-B2). This is the ONLY reading where
                                          the two-base axis matters, which is why it is in.
  zero- vs sign-extension                 identical for dd <= 0x7F; separated ONLY by dd = FF
                                          (k=15 vs k=255) and dd = 80
  modulo/wrapped buffer                   dd = 40/7F fold back instead of running on
  pre- vs post-increment                  C CANNOT separate these — both leave p at B+dd.
                                          Stage E separates them: post stores at mem[B],
                                          pre stores at mem[B+dd]. Stated explicitly because two
                                          candidates predicting the same thing must be named.
  mode 3 = "mode 2 | mode 1" (the §131
    bitwise suggestion)                   predicts BOTH: C shows k = s8(addr8) AND E finds the
                                          carrier in reg[addr8]. Any other combination refutes it.
  store target                            carrier in mem[B] => pointer target; in reg[dd] and
                                          tracking dd => register-file target; nowhere after the
                                          32-run exhaustive scan, WITH both positive controls
                                          hitting => the store is suppressed for that mode.
  class C vs class 4 (§161's assumption)  D must reproduce C's k and E's target; any difference
                                          means bit 3 is not purely cursor-fetch.
ranked.negative:
A NEGATIVE for a given mode is concrete and reportable: the 4-bit readout equals the NOP null's (k = 0) for all nine displacements at BOTH bases, AND stage E's exhaustive 32-run scan finds the carrier in no D-RAM cell and no register — i.e. the word neither moves the pointer nor stores anywhere observable. That is exactly what §161's downgraded claim predicts for mode 4, and it would confirm it on synthesised rather than membership-selected evidence.

This is kept distinct from an ABORT, which is not a result: (a) stage A fails to reproduce mode 2's published k = s8(addr8) or mode 0's k = 0 — the skeleton is wrong, report nothing; (b) the carrier is absent in every run including the positive controls — the readout path is shut, report nothing; (c) the probe word silences the frame at every dd including dd = 00 while the NOP null sounds — the word is not executable outside its native context, report "not characterisable this way" and not "no effect".
ranked.control: Four, in increasing strength. (1) NO-STIMULUS WINDOW: stock unmodified 45-word kernel, carrier injected, probe absent — establishes what the return path does with no probe at all, so a tone we later see is demonstrably ours (RULE 13). (2) NOP NULL: identical program, S5 replaced by kernel w42 `0000200000` — readout must be k = 0 and the carrier must sit at mem[B]. (3) KNOWN-ANSWER CONTROLS: the same skeleton with X = 0 and X = 2, whose addressing is already characterised; the probe must return the published answers before any open mode is run. (4) DECOY READOUT: reg[0xC4] in stage E, a register no probe word names, must stay silent in every run — a positive hit there would mean the register readout itself is contaminated.

commands: LOAD (one 5-byte word: patch addr8 of the single class-6 word in place; also to install a minimal program if the shipped vehicle proves unusable)
POKE tag 0x15 (register-file/table space 0x1D..0x44 - the ramp, the delta tables, the sentinels) and tag 0x26 (C-RAM, for the parameter sweeps)
RUN - free-run for audio capture, AND RUN n with n=1,2,3 for the per-frame index-advance test
DUMP - CPU-2 RAM only, to prove the poke stream was actually emitted (NOT a DSP read; no DSP memory readback exists)
ranked.readback: (b) AUDIO OUTPUT, as a traced transfer curve - not a DC level. The DSP is a send/return insert; with 100% wet and a sustained carrier, the return sampled against the input gives y = table[index(x)] point by point. Amplitude/waveform, so it survives AC coupling at the line out (a DC readout would not, and that is why DC is rejected here). For V-B (no audio input) the readout is the LFO waveform itself, demodulated to phase(t). Capture 10 s at 48 kHz/24-bit. A 32-plateau ramp gives 0.025 FS steps, ~30 dB above a -70 dBFS floor. GF1-3 is NOT used: both its wiring and the GF-setting instruction are unproven, and 3 bits cannot carry an index trajectory.
flaws: VEHICLE DOES NOT EXIST ON THE ONLY MACHINE WE HAVE. The monitor is in the WSA1R ROM and Felipe has the WSA1R (KN5000 is abroad). But wsa1/dsp/disasm/kernel.dsm - the ONLY program that ever executes in play - has ZERO class-6 words and zero C63 words (grep -cE '\.6\.' -> 0). EXCITER's class-6 words are w11/w45 of eff03_exciter.dsm, a body at I-RAM 0x6E that raw-bus capture proves is NEVER uploaded (firmware-gated). So 'the SHIPPED programs, unmodified... every executed word stays proven silicon' is FALSE: V-A/V-B require LOADing a 69-word unexecuted body, plus its C-RAM stream, plus rewriting the kernel's per-unit call-vector - three unproven mechanisms the design never names.

THE TABLE IS POKED INTO A CHIP THAT DOES NOT EXECUTE. ranked.probe:
CORE IDEA — do not propose a seventh index formula. Make the TABLE the readout: the class-6 table port is host-writable (mode-1 register file 0x1D.., tag 0x15, §178/§179), so replace the table with an INJECTIVE ramp and the DSP's own output prints the index. Candidate-free by construction.

Vehicle: the SHIPPED programs, unmodified except for data and ONE field. Every executed word stays proven silicon. Two vehicles because the idiom has two families:
 V-A = EXCITER (waveshaper, class-6 word 0006284CD, addr8=0x28=40, 32-cell soft-clip curve at 0x1D..0x3C)
 V-B = PEQ (LFO, class-6 word 0006184CD, addr8=0x18=24, 24-entry sine + 8 wrap-guard copies)

G0 INSTRUMENT GATE (run first, nothing downstream is interpretable without it).
 Load EXCITER normally. Play a slow full-scale carrier (one sustained low note, 100% wet, dry muted), capture line out, and plot y(t) against x(t) delay-aligned: that traces the TRANSFER CURVE, i.e. table[index(x)], one point per index.
 (a) No-stimulus window: no note -> output must be flat/zero (RULE 13 baseline).
 (b) Round-trip: traced curve must reproduce §178's 32 measured values (-0.495 .. +0.491, odd-symmetric about 0x2D). This is the first silicon check of §178, which exists only as an emulator capture.
 (c) Visibility: POKE ONE cell, 0x2D (the zero crossing), to +0.90. A spike must appear in the traced curve at exactly the x where it crossed zero. If it does not, the poke does not reach the running effect, or class-6 does not read the register file -> STOP.

P1 INDEX READOUT (what forms the index).
 POKE 0x1D..0x3C with an injective ramp: cell 0x1D+k = (k-16)/40 FS (32 plateaus, 0.025 FS = ~32 dBFS steps apart, trivially resolved).
 V-A: the traced y-vs-x curve is now literally index(x) x (1/40). Read off directly: slope (=> 40/2^23 vs 32/2^23 scaling), whether it uses signed x or |x| (folding), offset, clamp points, and monotonicity. If the curve shows N distinct plateaus per input excursion, N is the reachable index count.
 V-B: with the same ramp in PEQ and NO audio input, the output becomes a ramp-shaped LFO. Demodulate/capture it: the envelope IS phase(t). That gives the per-frame index increment on real silicon (also bears on the §120 LFO-rate defect).
 Window width W (the 8-cell guard implies a windowed/interpolating read): POKE a DELTA table (entry j = FS, all others 0) and sweep j = 0..31, one run each. If a delta lights up for exactly one x-interval, W=1; if it lights up for several adjacent index positions, the response shape IS the interpolation kernel.
 Host sweeps, one variable at a time, ramp table installed: input LEVEL (velocity/send, 8 steps), the C-RAM parameter cells the program's own laws map (host_side.py laws), and RUN n = 1,2,3,... at frozen input to test per-frame advance.

P2 40-vs-32 (settled by the SAME instrument).
 (i) Sentinels past the window: POKE 0x3D..0x44 with values of a sign no in-window entry has (all negative, magnitudes 0.60..0.95 distinguishable) while 0x1D..0x3C hold the positive ramp. Drive the carrier to full scale. If sentinel values appear in the traced curve, the read runs past 0x3C and addr8=40 really is a range over 40 cells (and loud EXCITER input is audibly wrong on hardware, at ~80% FS). If entries 0..7 reappear at the top, it is modulo-32 aliasing. If entry 31 holds flat, it is a clamp. If the top of the range gives zero/garbage, addr8 is not a range at all.
 (ii) The decisive discrimination, MODULUS vs SCALE: patch ONLY the addr8 field of the one class-6 word via LOAD, over {0x10, 0x18, 0x20, 0x28, 0x30, 0x40}, tables unchanged.
   - modulus/count reading predicts: the low and mid parts of the traced curve are IDENTICAL across all addr8; only the high end (wrap/clamp point) moves.
   - scale reading predicts: the x-axis rescales by 1/addr8 EVERYWHERE, visible at small input levels too.
   These predictions differ at small x, where they separate cleanly. This is the test §178 left open when it withdrew "addr8 is the entry count".
ranked.discriminates:
The probe does not test candidates; it READS the index function off the output. It therefore adjudicates all six refuted forms at once, on silicon rather than on the LLE's own internals (which is what refuted three of them):
 - index = (n x acc) >> 23 / any scaling of the sample: traced curve is a straight ramp in x with slope n/2^23, and the slope CHANGES when addr8 is patched.
 - index = acc mod n: traced curve is a SAWTOOTH in x, folding n times across the input range.
 - index = |x| or folded: curve is symmetric about x=0 with plateaus repeating on both sides.
 - index = a frame/phase counter independent of the signal: V-A's curve is FLAT in x (no dependence) while V-B's LFO readout moves - and RUN n stepping shows a fixed increment per frame.
 - index = an internal state we cannot set: flat under every host sweep AND flat under RUN n. That is still a decoded fact (it excludes every host-reachable source) and it is reachable by this probe.
40-vs-32: modulus and scale make OPPOSITE predictions at small input levels (high-end-only change vs global x-axis rescaling), and the sentinels beyond 0x3C separate "reads past the window" from "wraps" from "clamps" from "unmapped" by the SIGN of the recovered value - four mutually exclusive traces.
ranked.negative:
Three distinct reachable negatives.
 1. G0(c) fails: poking 0x2D changes nothing in the traced curve. Then either the tag-0x15 write does not reach a running effect, or the class-6 word does not source from the mode-1 register file on hardware - which would retract §178/§179's table-port identification (measured in the emulator only). The probe dies here and says which, because DUMP proves the poke was emitted.
 2. P1 negative: with the injective ramp installed, the traced curve shows fewer than ~4 distinguishable plateaus, or plateaus in an order unrelated to the ramp. Then the fetched value is not what reaches the output in this vehicle (the idiom's third word may consume it elsewhere) and the vehicle must be replaced before anything is claimed.
 3. P2 negative: no sentinel value ever appears at any input level up to clipping, AND the addr8 patch produces no change in the traced curve at any level. Then addr8 is neither a modulus nor a scale for the waveshaper family, and §157's surviving "five agreed values" fact has no operational reading - a real, publishable null that closes the field.
Instrument-sees-the-failure gate for P2 specifically: before reporting "no sentinels reached", write the NEGATIVE sentinels INTO the in-window cells 0x35..0x3C and confirm they appear in the trace. If negatives never render in-window, the sign detection is broken and the absence means nothing.
ranked.control:
Four controls, all pre-registered.
 C1 no-stimulus: note off, program loaded, capture. Output must be flat (RULE 13 - a difference from silence is not a signal).
 C2 flat-table null: POKE all 32 cells to a single constant +0.50. The output must be a clean scaled copy of the carrier with NO curve structure and NO modulation, at every addr8. Any structure here means something other than the table reaches the output, and every P1/P2 reading is contaminated.
 C3 restore: re-POKE the original §178 values; the traced curve must return to the published table exactly. This validates the whole poke-to-audio chain in both directions and is the round-trip the emulator capture has never had on silicon.
 C4 addr8 control for P2: repeat the sentinel run at addr8 = 0x20 (32). The sentinel excursions must DISAPPEAR. If they persist at addr8 = 32, the effect is not addr8-driven and the sentinel result must be discarded.
 C5 two-constant gain check: flat tables at 0.25 and 0.75 must change the output amplitude by ~3x, proving the readout's amplitude axis is calibrated before any table value is inferred from it.

POKE C-RAM (canaries + the gate coefficient; also the chopper, so it must be fast and accept single-cell writes while the DSP runs)
POKE D-RAM-register (identity marker fill; optional, has an in-program fallback)
RUN — needs a FREE-RUN/until-STOP variant, not just RUN n, because the chopper pokes while the DSP is running
DUMP (host-side sanity only: verify what the monitor staged; it CANNOT read the DSP)
ranked.readback:
(b) AUDIO, with a host-synchronous chopper. The last two body words compute out = (C-RAM[G] x value_cell)>>6 and store it to the output cell; the host toggles C-RAM[G] between 0x000000 and 0x400000 at 47 Hz while recording the line out. Lock-in detect at 47 Hz: amplitude = |value|, phase = sign. A constant would be DC and invisible through AC coupling — the poked coefficient is what makes it AC, and it uses only the C-RAM write path (the same path every effect-parameter change already uses). Canaries are powers of two (6.02 dB apart); the poison 0.75 and every shift of it (1.5x2^-k) lands >= 3.5 dB off that ladder, so +/-1 dB metering suffices — no absolute calibration, and all candidates sit in ONE take at one gain setting.
NOT used: GF1-3. It is doubly unproven — the board wiring is unknown AND no GF-setting instruction has ever been located, so there is nothing to write the bits with. RQ is not used either.
Step 0, before any ACT word: with the stock kernel, POKE the candidate value cell through the ladder 0.5/0.25/.../0.03 and confirm the chop steps 6 dB each time. That single measurement finds the output cell, proves the write path reaches the audio, and calibrates value->amplitude. If nothing responds, the audio readback is dead and the whole plan stops there — 10 minutes, not after seven probes.

All THREE of the design's `the kernel itself executes ACT 0x0B` citations are escape words. Substituting lo12[4:0] there mutates a DRAM sub-op, not an action — and the word then performs a real delay-DRAM access at DESCRIPTOR_CELL[k]+G from a descriptor bank the probe never sets up. r1_allpass_solve.py still carries `an ESCAPE word's lo12: honoured / ignored` as an ENUMERATED OPEN parameter, so the design picked as its carrier precisely the family where the field's existence is unresolved.

THE ENTIRE BODY IS BUILT FROM THE WRONG CHIP'S KERNEL. The monitor runs on the WSA1R (IC30). Measured: all ten cited `kernel shapes` — 0692200415, 0410AFF647, 088012040B, 080016000B, 0400A0021A, 0282A01417, 0000AFF407, 009AA00200, 0010A0020C, 0202A00448 — occur **0 times** in wsa1/dsp/disasm/kernel.dsm. The project rule `build from the 45 words PROVEN to execute on real silicon` is violated silently on every word of the probe.

THE FILLER IS A TRAP WORD, NOT A PROVEN NO-OP — AND IT IS ALSO CONTROL (1). `0692200415`: hi12=0x692 -> bit4 SET (store), bit7 SET, hi12[3:1]=1, i.e. exactly the `(1,1)` cell where the three surviving store gates disagree and the device TRAPS. instruction-set.md notes the disputed accumulator CLEAR at (1,1) is unobservable ONLY when ACTION==0x00; this word's ACTION is 0x15, so the clear is LIVE and open. Eight of them sit between the paint and the WUT and can wipe the accumulator poison — and the same word is the null control, so a harness that clears acc passes its own null.

THE READER WRITES mem[p] TWICE AND ITS FAILURE MODE IS THE POISON. `0410AFF647`: hi12=0x410 -> bit4 set, bit7 clear, so the ADOPTED gate fires `mem[p] <- acc ; acc := 0` BEFORE the ALU, then ACT 0x07 writes L to the same cell. acc deliberately holds the poison P. Any failure of ACT 0x07 (ordering, gating, or the reading itself) leaves P in the read cell => EVERY reader lights up for EVERY X including the null word. The project's classic cannot-fail shape, inverted into a guaranteed false positive.

THERE IS NO C-RAM ADDRESSING. Coefficients arrive only through the cursor (`class4==A : P := coef[cursor++] * L`), and the cursor base is a per-unit BASE REGISTER whose value is in NO instruction immediate (output-stage-decode, K4 item D). `POKE C-RAM[0xC0..0xC6]` and `LOAD acc<-C-RAM[0x400000]` name cells and values the probe has no mechanism to select; which cells the body actually reads depends on how many cursor-fetch words the kernel executed before it. Every canary, and the chopper gate, is at an unknown address.

THE READBACK CHIP MAY NOT BE IN THE AUDIO PATH, AND THE DESIGN NEVER ASKS. Measured in-emulator: IC30 = PROGRAM DSP with a resident I-RAM kernel and **empty C-RAM, byte-identical across all 55 effects**; IC6/IC5 = COEFFICIENT DSPs with C-RAM and no I-RAM. So (a) the claim `it uses only the C-RAM write path (the same path every effect-parameter change already uses)` is FALSE for IC30 — effect changes write IC6/IC5 and never IC30; (b) if IC30's coefficients are genuinely all zero at runtime, every class-A multiply in it, the chopper's own `coef x value` included, yields 0 and the emit is structurally silent. This is the largest unexamined dependency and it sits underneath the whole readback.

I-RAM 0x6E IS THE KERNEL'S LAST WORD, NOT A FREE SLOT. Kernel loads at 0x30, 63 words => I-RAM 48..110, last word at 110 = 0x6E (matches the measured `words 48..110 = load 0x30..0x6E`). THE WORD COUNT IS INFLATED 2-3x. Measured (dsp/tools/act_field_census.py, committed 426650c6): of the sites carrying one of the seven target ACT bit-patterns, KN5000 has 119 = 10 C-format + 60 ESCAPE + **49 CLEAN**; WSA1R has 196 = 8 C-format + 131 ESCAPE + **57 CLEAN**.
